projection.retained: All scenarios, all assertions including expected/actual/outcome, all original totals, CLI stdout/stderr, manifests, filesystem diffs and temporary leftovers.
projection.omitted: Raw argv, GG environment values and setup metadata; complete tree snapshots except S08/S11. No assertion or failure is omitted or regraded.
projection.substitutions: Only the checkout and QA scratch prefixes become role aliases. Relative paths, values, ordering and all outcomes stay unchanged.

method.isolation: minimal child env built by the driver; GG_DATA_DIR always a fixture; USERPROFILE/HOME/TEMP/TMP/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA inside the run folder; GG_DB_URL only when the scenario configures one
method.ownershipFixtures: held/stale locks and guards produced by the checkout's built apps/api/dist/data-dir-lock.js and windows-process-identity.js in holder processes (killed with SIGKILL to leave stale records)
method.store: real current-format store seeded by packages/infrastructure/dist/sqlite openDatabase+migrate with two run IDs (database + WAL copy)

kinds.acceptance: #434 acceptance criterion; expected to FAIL on an unfixed baseline
kinds.safety: must hold on baseline and candidate (no unrelated or unowned change)
kinds.positive: existing documented behaviour / control expected to hold
kinds.interpretive: QA reading beyond the literal acceptance text; reported, not gating
kinds.precondition: fixture precondition; dependent assertions are not-run when it fails

criteria.AC1: Dry-run and confirmed manifests accurately classify the database lock and its .reclaim guard
criteria.AC2: Completion and failure messages identify directory and database locks accurately
criteria.AC3: Confirmed runs preserve unrelated files; only owned metadata/content is removed
